## Change and reason

Describe the problem, the change, and any linked issue.

## Verification

List the focused commands and actual browser/device/API flows exercised. State what remains unverified; distinguish emulator evidence from physical-device evidence. Use synthetic data only.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe any migration, configuration, enrollment, permission, retention, or deletion impact. Write “None” if there is none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Verification results above are accurate; untested behavior is identified.
- [ ] Consent, visible app identity, and Android permission controls are preserved.
- [ ] Existing device enrollment and the frozen API contract remain compatible, or an approved extension is documented.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain **no secrets, personal data, real recordings, private deployment configuration, or backups**.
